title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
description: Rise and shine, MAC Fellas, it is Saturday, October third. And the air cargo landscape is shifting fast this morning. First up, flydubai Cargo just launched its scheduled freighter network with three Boeing 737-800s to capture regional ecommerce demand. Narrowbody belly capacity has limits, so dedicated freighters could reshape regional trade flows. Meanwhile, Silk Way West is looking further ahead by ordering two Airbus A350F freighters. And LATAM Cargo is seeing a massive surge in Europe-Brazil pharma freight driven by GLP-1 drugs. Cold-chain demand like that is definitely one to watch. Have a great weekend, everyone.
